topography.project_purpose: Onchain Capital Allocator. Structurally: 189 project-authored contract(s) across 6 chain(s); 4 ERC4626 vaults, 16 ERC20 tokens, 15 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 30 common project-authored base contract(s) (aggor, auth, debttokenbase). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
